notes: Grinder brew recovery: pressing Brew on the grinder while the scale is off no longer fails. The screen waits up to 3 x 5 s (live countdown on the touch screen and this page, Cancel Brew throughout), checks scale and cup (>= 1 s of fresh stable measurements), then tares with a VERIFIED tare that re-checks the cup at the instant it zeroes, and only then starts the pump. Nothing starts after Cancel/STOP, a moved cup or a timeout. Faster scale connection. Needs scale 1.3.0 (update the scale first). Brew gate, normal TARE, timers, First Drip, Grind-by-Sync and updates are unchanged.
